sentences.text:
Date of Decision: 03.05.2025
Hardeep Singh And Another ......Petitioners
 Vs
State Of Haryana And Another ....Respondents

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Harkesh Manuj
 Manuja

Present: Mr. Garvit Mittal, Advocate
 for the petitioners.

petitioner
 Mr. Ravi Pratap Singh, D.A.G., Haryana

1. By way of instant petition, prayer has been made for issuance of direction to respondent No.1 to
refer the petition under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land
Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-
Re settlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter (hereinafter to the referred to as 'the 2013 Act') filed at the
instance of the petitioners-landowners petitioners to the authority concerned.

2.  It is has been pleaded that certain land owned by the petitioners situated in the revenue estate of village Bihta, Tehsil and Di District Ambala came to be acquired vide notification dated 28.10.2013 issued under Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 followed by notification dated 24.10.2014 under Section 6 thereof and the award was passed under Section 26 of the 2013 Act.

3. Aggrieved of the determination, the petitioners petitioners-landowners invoked Section 64 of the 2013 Act having filed reference before the Land Acquisition Collector, District Ambala which was received by the office on 01.03.2018.

sentences.text: At this stage, without without commenting upon merits of the quantum of compensation, the present petition is disposed of.

Respondent espondent No.1 is directed to forward the reference invoked by the petitioners petitioners, received in the office on 01.03.2018, to the Authority Authorit concerned at Ambala within one month from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

6. It is made clear that in case respondent No.1 fail fails to do the needful within the stipulated period, period his entire salary shall remain attached aas there is already delay of around 07 years in forwarding the reference.
A copy of this order be also forwarded to the office of Chief Secretary, H Haryana aryana for necessary compliance qua attachment of salary, if need be.
7. All pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.

(HARKE  (HARKESH MANUJA)
